pk.context: 20 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colourless, sugar-free oral solution in a bottle

tell: Its potent metabolite endoxifen depends on CYP2D6 genotype, and CYP2D6 inhibitors cut endoxifen levels.

clues.text: Bioavailability is the same fed or fasted, and the oral solution is bioequivalent to tablets. Fecal excretion is the primary route of elimination.
The active moiety has a molecular weight of 371.5 and is the trans-isomer of a triphenylethylene derivative.
Approved under an NDA as an oral solution supplied in a 150 mL bottle with a dosing cup. Dosed once daily.
Boxed warning for uterine malignancies and thromboembolic events, including stroke and pulmonary embolism. Contraindicated in known hypersensitivity; hot flashes are the most frequent reaction.
Metastatic and early-stage breast cancer, reducing invasive breast cancer risk after DCIS surgery and radiation, and prevention in high-risk women.
Competes with estrogen for binding to the estrogen receptor, reducing estrogen-driven growth in breast tissue.
The generic name begins with T and has nine letters.
